confidence_notes: Two web searches were run: one for the RBA rate and one for Muscat food and drink prices. The RBA observation is 0.6720 USD per AUD as at 18 November 2026. The search summary reported it, and I did not open the RBA page myself. Coffee and inexpensive meal figures are consistent across several 2026 cost-of-living aggregators. The mid-range meal for two is uncertain because sources ranged from about $17 to $39, so I chose a middle value. Beer is only sold in licensed hotels and bars, and its price is high and varies by venue. Cocktail and wine are not directly sourced. I set them from the hotel-bar beer price, at roughly the same level as beer for cocktails and slightly above it for wine. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no listings checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other Gulf cities with restricted alcohol licensing, such as Dubai and Doha, but with lower food and accommodation prices.
